browser: Real Google Chrome through CUA extension
implementation: Production cad-dwg plugin, production Worker and 0.14-anyfile.1 runtime
inputMethod: Explicit fixture whitelist on loopback; no remote drawing upload

r2Success.visible: Architectural model-space drawing with linework, text, cached dimensions, leaders and basic hatch geometry; layer controls and source link visible

sameOriginFallback.trigger: R2 initialization exceeded the 20-second attempt budget during earlier runs
sameOriginFallback.note: Direct navigation to asset metadata also reported ERR_BLOCKED_BY_CLIENT in this session; later R2 initialization succeeded. Browser settings were not changed.

cancellation.trigger: Abort 20 ms after posting the open request to the initialized Worker

limitations: Viewport-ready timings include initialization and scene creation, not an exact first-painted-frame measurement
Native file picker automation is not covered
No per-object comparison with AutoCAD or ODA; no other browser certification

repeatThreeTimes.note: Three additional completed opens after the success and cancellation cases; each used the R2 source without fallback.
